title: People Can Follow Your WordPress Blog Like a Social Account
content:
Did you know… 🤓

…that you can gain followers on your WordPress blog, just like on social media platforms?

There’s a huge network called the Fediverse that connects independent platforms, instead of everything being owned by a single corporation. With the free WordPress plugin “ActivityPub,” you can make your WordPress blog part of it.

That means: people on Mastodon and other platforms can follow your blog, read your posts, like them, and comment on them, without ads or a centralized algorithm. Your content remains yours!
